metrics.Numerator: Isolates with result S for that organism-agent pair
metrics.Denominator: Isolates with any interpreted result (S, I, R or NS) for that pair
metrics.Period: The selected analysis period; 12 months unless narrowed
metrics.Deduplication: First isolate per patient per organism per period (CLSI M39)
metrics.Standard: CLSI M39 presentation convention; interpretation per the breakpoint standard and edition recorded on each result
metrics.Suppression: Percentage withheld below 30 isolates; the count is still shown
metrics.Intended use: Describing susceptibility patterns in a defined population and period, for stewardship and empirical-therapy review by a clinical governance group
metrics.Not to be used for: Choosing therapy for an individual patient, comparing facilities without agreed case mix, or pooling across sectors

metrics.Numerator: Isolates with result R for that organism-agent pair
metrics.Denominator: Isolates with any interpreted result for that pair
metrics.Deduplication: First isolate per patient per organism per period
metrics.Standard: Breakpoint standard and edition as recorded per result
metrics.Intended use: Trend and burden description within one sector
metrics.Not to be used for: Inferring transmission, or adding to %S to reach 100 -- intermediate and non-susceptible results occupy the remainder

metrics.Deduplication: Optional; stated wherever the count is shown
metrics.Standard: Platform definition: one isolate is one organism from one specimen, however many agents were tested against it
metrics.Suppression: None; counts are shown at any size
metrics.Intended use: Pathogen distribution, denominators, and judging whether a rate is supportable
metrics.Not to be used for: Standing in for patient or infection counts -- one patient may contribute several isolates unless deduplication is applied

metrics.Deduplication: Inherent; the pseudonym is the unit
metrics.Standard: Facility-scoped salted pseudonym; a patient at two facilities counts twice by design, since the platform cannot and should not link them
metrics.Intended use: Denominators for patient-level rates and judging deduplication impact
metrics.Not to be used for: Counting individuals nationally, for the reason above

metrics.Numerator: Specimens with one or more isolates
metrics.Deduplication: None; the specimen is the unit
metrics.Intended use: Laboratory workload, sampling yield, and detecting under-reporting of negative cultures
metrics.Not to be used for: Infection incidence -- specimens are not sampled at random from any population

metrics.Numerator: Records with a non-empty value that is not 'Unknown'
metrics.Standard: Platform definition; 'Unknown' counts as missing, because a stored placeholder carries no information
metrics.Intended use: Directing data-quality effort and qualifying every other figure on this page
metrics.Not to be used for: Judging laboratory performance in isolation -- a field may be absent because the collection form never asked for it

deduplication: First isolate per subject per organism per period (CLSI M39). Kept 2,502 of 2,667 isolates between 2024-03-02 and 2026-09-01 (6.2% removed as repeats) across 1,769 subject(s). 311 of them (11.7%) carried no subject identifier and were kept as distinct, since repeat sampling cannot be detected without one.
